provenance.source: bash builtin: help read: "read: read [-Eers] [-a array] [-d delim] [-i text] [-n nchars] [-N nchars] [-p prompt] [-t timeout] [-u fd] [name ...]"

stdin.source: bash builtin: help read: "Reads a single line from the standard input, or from file descriptor FD if the -u option is supplied."

stdout.source: bash builtin: help read: "Read a line from the standard input and split it into fields." (no explicit stdout wording in the reviewed text; the documented effect is assignment of the fields to the named variables or REPLY, so classified "none")

unknownFlag.source: bash builtin: help read: full option listing reviewed; "-u fd read from file descriptor FD instead of the standard input" reads content from a descriptor this model cannot see and is deliberately left unmodeled, so this repo's fail-closed default ("insufficient") applies

citation.source: bash builtin: help read: "-N nchars return only after reading exactly NCHARS characters, unless EOF is encountered or read times out, ignoring any delimiter"
bash builtin: help read: "-a array assign the words read to sequential indices of the array variable ARRAY, starting at zero"
bash builtin: help read: "-d delim continue until the first character of DELIM is read, rather than newline"
bash builtin: help read: "-e use Readline to obtain the line"
bash builtin: help read: "-i text use TEXT as the initial text for Readline"
bash builtin: help read: "-n nchars return after reading NCHARS characters rather than waiting for a newline"
bash builtin: help read: "-p prompt output the string PROMPT without a trailing newline before attempting to read"
bash builtin: help read: "-r do not allow backslashes to escape any characters"
bash builtin: help read: "-s do not echo input coming from a terminal"
bash builtin: help read: "-t timeout time out and return failure if a complete line of input is not read within TIMEOUT seconds"
bash builtin: help read: "read [name ...]" and "If no NAMEs are supplied, the line read is stored in the REPLY variable."
